title: Return Refund Amounts, Return Fees and Refund Tender — Northgate Purchases & Returns Clauses
content:
These clauses of Northgate Purchases & Returns set how much a return refunds, which return fees can fall on it, where the refund is paid and how the purchase status follows the refunds. Three clauses originally in this set are marked below as no longer in force.

## Clauses in force

**1. No double refund.** Units already refunded on a sale line are never refunded again: a return covers at most the units still kept on that line, that is, the units sold on the line less every unit already refunded against it.

**2. Waived reasons.** Neither a restocking fee nor a changed-mind freight pickup fee is charged for a return reason the channel lists as waived (defective, not as described, damaged in transit, missing parts or not received).

**3. Refund tender.** The refund goes to the purchase's tender, or to a Northgate Shop Card when that tender is one the channel refunds on a Shop Card.

**4. Surcharge and delivery fee.** The non-member surcharge on a returned line is refunded with it where the channel refunds the surcharge with the line. The delivery fee is refunded when the purchase ends fully returned and every refund on it carried a reason in the channel's list of delivery-fee refund reasons.

**5. Status after a refund.** After each refund the purchase becomes partially returned while any sold unit remains unrefunded, and fully returned when none does.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis, and none may be applied:

- *Refund per unit:* "Each returned unit is refunded at its sale unit price, less the per-unit price adjustment already credited when adjusted units are refunded at their adjusted price, and less the per-unit rebate already paid when a mail-in rebate was paid on the line." — no longer in force.
- *Restocking on a changed-mind return:* "A changed-mind return on a channel with a restocking percentage is charged that percentage of the refund as a restocking fee entry." — no longer in force.
- *Changed-mind freight pickup:* "A changed-mind freight pickup is charged the channel's changed-mind pickup fee as a return pickup fee entry." — no longer in force.

## Status after a refund — worked cases (hypothetical)

| Units sold on the purchase | Units refunded before | Units in this refund | Status afterwards |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0 | 1 | partially returned |
| 4 | 1 | 3 | fully returned |
| 4 | 4 | — | no refund; no unit remains kept |

superseded_clauses: a changed_mind freight pickup is charged changed_mind_pickup_fee_usd as a return_pickup_fee entry
A changed_mind return on a channel with a restocking_fee_pct is charged that percentage of the refund as a restocking_fee entry

Each returned unit is refunded at order_msr_sale_unit_price, less the per-unit price adjustment already credited when returned_units_reprice_adjusted is true, and less order_msr_rebated_unit_credit when a mail-in rebate was paid on the line.
